title: Abandoned Amusement Park
description: A top-down view of a neglected amusement park featuring a central yin-yang patterned plaza with a fountain, a large pipe organ on the left, a small purple steam train on tracks, a Ferris wheel on the right, and scattered colorful flags and petals. Roller coaster tracks curve around the decaying scene.
